_comment: #419 java pilot — complete classification of ALL 143 public named node types in the pinned tree-sitter-java wasm. Every type is bucketed; a type in no bucket is itself a gate failure (silence is guilt). Buckets: handled_verified (analyzer emits correctly, probe/fixture-confirmed), internal_silent (container/literal/keyword correctly emitting nothing itself), gap (confirmed missing emission, numbered G1..), design_decision (owner ruling required before closure). Generated mechanically + probe-verified 2026-08-26 (see script/m14/completeness-inventory.ts).

handled_verified._description: Node types whose required emissions are produced and verified by probes and/or existing F3 fixtures
handled_verified._verified_by: live analyzer probes on synthetic fixtures (record patterns aside) + existing F3 fixtures + differential corpus (grails-core@a83f87480e)

internal_silent._description: Containers, wrappers, grouping nodes, literals, and keywords whose named children are walked independently — emitting nothing at this node is correct

_notes.type_bound: generic bound container (T extends Number) — the bound TYPE reference is not emitted; tracked as design_decision G6, the container itself is correctly silent
_notes.template_expression: Java 21 string templates / text blocks — embedded expressions are walked and their calls/uses emitted; the template wrapper itself is silent
_notes.synchronized_statement: not a decision point per McCabe; block body walked
_notes.static_initializer: symbol: null per spec table; body IS walked but calls inside it are lost — tracked as gap G4

gap._description: Confirmed missing emissions (probe-verified: the analyzer emits nothing where the spec table requires an emission)

gaps.missing: Uses relationship on the array expression
gaps.evidence: probe: class A { int[] xs; void f(int i) { xs[i] = 5; int v = xs[i]; } } emits contains only — no uses on xs for reads or writes
probe: class A { A() { super(); } } emits no calls
gaps.spec_row: declarations.constructor_declaration — constructor delegation is a call edge

gaps.missing: Type reference for the record type in instanceof Point(int x, int y)
gaps.evidence: probe: if (o instanceof Point p) emits instanceof_check, but if (o instanceof Point(int a, int b)) emits nothing

gaps.missing: Calls relationships for invocations outside method bodies: static initializers, instance initializers, field initializers, enum constant bodies
gaps.evidence: probes: static { x = compute(); }, { x = compute(); }, static int x = compute(), enum { int x = compute(); } all emit no calls. Root cause: src/ast/real-java-analyzer.ts method_invocation handler guards on parentContext.kind === SymbolKind.Method, so calls attributed to no method scope are dropped; qualified_calls likewise never recorded

design_decision._description: Items where the correct emission is a ruling, not a defect. Closure requires an explicit owner decision recorded here

decisions.node_type: module_declaration, requires_module_directive, requires_modifier, exports_module_directive, opens_module_directive, uses_module_directive, provides_module_directive
decisions.question: module-info.java currently emits zero symbols and zero relationships. Options: (a) declare module-info out of scope (documented limitation), (b) emit requires/exports/uses targets as References/imports (dependency edges)
decisions.recommendation: (a) declare out of scope — module-info is rare, low-value for AI code understanding, and the analyzer already extracts imports elsewhere
decisions.ruling: (a) DECLARED OUT OF SCOPE — owner approval 2026-08-26. module-info.java is a documented limitation; requires/exports/opens/uses/provides emit no edges by design

decisions.question: generic bound types (class Box<T extends Number & Comparable<T>>) emit no type references for Number/Comparable. Options: (a) emit declared_type references for bounds, (b) declare limitation (bounds captured only as type_parameter names)
decisions.recommendation: (b) declare limitation — bounds are rarely load-bearing for AI consumers; type_parameters payload already records parameter names
decisions.ruling: (b) DECLARED LIMITATION — owner approval 2026-08-26. type_bound emits no type references; typeParameters payload carries the parameter names

decisions.question: java-spec-table.json lists these in statements_affecting_complexity, but calculateJavaMethodComplexity does not count them (standard McCabe counts only if/while/for/do/case/catch/&&/||/ternary). Either the spec table over-claims or the analyzer under-counts
decisions.recommendation: correct the spec table (remove from complexity list) — matches the analyzer, matches textbook McCabe, and keeps complexity comparable across JVM languages (CC1 contract)
decisions.ruling: SPEC TABLE CORRECTED — owner approval 2026-08-26: throw_statement, assert_statement, try_with_resources_statement removed from statements_affecting_complexity in java-spec-table.json

decisions.question: The analyzer queues override tasks only for methods carrying @Override. Most real Java omits the annotation (clojure/ASF code) — are un-annotated overrides relationships?
decisions.resolution: Yes — JLS 8.4.8: @Override is a compile-time check, not a requirement; an un-annotated instance method whose signature matches an accessible ancestor method overrides it. Two-corpus gate wave 2026-09 (clojure:java SubVector.iterator). The analyzer now queues implicit tasks for every non-static, non-private, non-constructor instance method, but emits ONLY on a verified exact-signature in-file match (pass 1). Explicit @Override tasks alone keep the companion-index (pass 2) and first-parent guess (pass 3) tiers, so overloads never fabricate.

decisions.question: The override TRUTH pairs by method NAME only — same-name-different-signature overloads (SubVector.nth(int) vs APersistentVector.nth(int, Object)) were asserted as overrides. Signature-exact?
decisions.resolution: Yes. Two-corpus gate wave 2026-09: the shared oracle collected members with the return type / nested-type-name bugs (the /identifier/ test matched type_identifier first and the field_declaration|declaration guard swallowed method_declaration AND let nested class_declaration through). All fixed: method names come from the grammar name field, member collection is field_declaration-only for variables with nested type nodes excluded, and override pair emission is signature-aware (parameter-type signature overlap required when both sides record signatures). Private ancestor methods never pair (JLS 8.4.8.1).

decisions.question: M37.21 #610 user-suspect wave: methods inside anonymous bodies were attributed to the enclosing class (contains Service->compare on the probe) and no symbol existed for the anonymous type.
decisions.resolution: Mirror the kotlin family convention: anonymous_<SuperName> Class symbol (noise name, never leaks into the index), ownerName = enclosing type, scope pushed for the class_body so members attribute to the anonymous type (contains anonymous_Comparator->compare). object_creation_expression handler pushes the scope; exit-scheduling is the walk's uniform tail. Fixture java/anonymous-and-multihop-overrides pins both directions (expect + forbid contains Service->compare/run); mutants java/anonymous-body-scope-leak + java/override-multihop-bare-name.

decisions.node_type: multi-hop nested-class override resolution (BlackVal extends Black extends Node)
decisions.question: M37.21 #610 clojure PersistentTreeMap: overrides through a NON-declaring ancestor (BlackVal.val -> Node.val, Black declares no val) were lost — classHierarchy is FQN-keyed but parents are bare leaf names, so hop-2 looked up classHierarchy with the bare name and missed.
decisions.resolution: Suffix-resolve every bare parent name to its FQN candidate(s) during the BFS; symbolMap method-symbol hits disambiguate same-named classes. JLS 8.4.8.1 nearest-declaring-ancestor semantics unchanged (BFS level-by-level, private-ancestor skip). Both java lanes 100%/0/0 at 200 files after the fix.

decisions.question: M37.21 #610 user-suspect: method_invocation targets collapse overloads to the bare leaf name (callExpression.split('.').pop()) — two same-name overloads are indistinguishable.
decisions.resolution: Deliberate contract: the universal call graph is name-leaf based family-wide (java/kotlin/scala/groovy/php/ruby/python all emit leaf targets); overload signature matching requires type inference the tree-sitter layer does not have. Recorded so a downstream consumer needing overload identity knows the boundary. Not a defect.

decisions.node_type: varargs vs array-type override equivalence (foo(int...) vs foo(int[]))
decisions.question: M37.21 #610 user-suspect: signature strings built from parameters[i].type might not normalize int... and int[] to the same string, silently missing overrides.
decisions.resolution: Probe-verified on the exact JLS shape: @Override void foo(int[] xs) over varargs foo(int... xs) AND the reverse (bar(int...) over bar(int[])) both resolve (Child.foo->Base.foo, Child.bar->Base.bar). extractJavaParameterType already normalizes. No change.

decisions.question: M37.21 #610 user-suspect: collectJavaTypeNames might descend only into the first union member inside catch_formal_parameter.
decisions.resolution: Probe-verified: all three union members emit references (IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException, IndexOutOfBoundsException). No change.

decisions.question: M37.21 #610 user-suspect #4: filterChildren defined and never called — dead code.
C3: all ctors emitted the literal name 'constructor' — Contains edges from distinct classes collided (A->constructor vs B->constructor) and overloads were indistinguishable
decisions.decision: Ctor symbols carry their CLASS NAME (A, kind=constructor) mirroring the csharp family convention. Fixtures ctor-delegation / ctor-value-injection / record-varargs-compact-ctor re-pinned 2026-09-08; mutant java/anonymous-body-scope-leak unchanged, java/return-type-refs-drop + java/per-segment-builtin-filter added (346/346)

decisions.node_type: cast_type / var locals in References graph
decisions.question: C4: `var x = foo()` emitted References foo->var — var is an inference keyword, not a type; cast positions already filtered but locals/params/formals did not
decisions.decision: var filtered at ALL declared-type positions (locals, params, formals, fields). Probe-verified: zero var edges on the C4 probe source

decisions.question: C5: per-segment check dropped user calls whose MID-CHAIN segment collides with a stdlib root (com.mycompany.Service.doWork on 'com', foo.Logger.bar on 'Logger')
decisions.decision: ROOT segment only (segments[0]) + exact-match list. Mid-chain collisions never suppress; static-imported bare names (println, assertEquals) remain emitted (documented under-filter, conservative). Oracle mirror updated in lockstep (isJavaBuiltinCall). Fixture root-segment-builtin-filter pins; mutant java/per-segment-builtin-filter

decisions.node_type: Spring route / httpMethod extraction (@GetMapping, @RequestMapping, array values, concat values)
decisions.question: C6/C7/C8/C23: bare @GetMapping fabricated route '/'; method=GET on @RequestMapping ignored; {"/a","/b"} array leaked raw text; "/a"+"/b" and text blocks leaked raw source
decisions.decision: Empty class+method paths yield NO api endpoint edge (no fabricated '/'); @RequestMapping reads method= (default GET for mapping-style, ANY only when explicitly unspecified-semantic); element_value_array_initializer joins values; extractStringValue constant-folds + chains (literals/text blocks/parens only) and reads multiline_string_fragment for text blocks. Probe-verified: /a/b folded, text block unquoted

decisions.question: C9: fields/params/locals/catch/throws emitted declared_type edges but method return types emitted zero edges (List<User> getUsers() -> nothing)
decisions.decision: Return positions emit References (declared_type, declaredOn=return_type, conf 0.95). type-usage-graph fixture lifted its stale forbid on R and now PINS the R return edge; mutant java/return-type-refs-drop

decisions.question: C10: method complexity counted switch_rule (arrow switches) but the file-level walk did not — file total != sum(methods)+1
decisions.decision: Both sides count the same decision-point set (if/for/enhanced_for/while/do/catch/switch_block_statement_group/switch_rule/ternary/&&/||). Probe: method=4 file=4 parity. complexity-parity fixture guards

decisions.question: C20/C21: substring tests (indexOf('Data'), indexOf('JpaRepository')) fired on @Metadata/@Database/MyJpaRepositoryFoo; phantom Spring-Data methods carried parameters:[] inconsistent with sig (Object)
decisions.decision: Exact short-name annotation test (hasJavaAnnotation) for Lombok; phantom accessors carry the matching (Object) parameter. Probe-verified

decisions.question: C11: suffixIndex rebuilt per override task O(T*C) + queue.shift() O(N) — contradicted the header's O(N) claim
decisions.decision: suffixIndex hoisted to build-once; shift replaced with head-index cursor. Corpus perf unchanged (already sub-ms/file), complexity now honest

decisions.question: C30 (user-suspect #1): anon body members attributed to the enclosing scope; no anonymous_<Super> symbol; classHierarchy never registered so @Override in anon bodies resolved to nothing
decisions.decision: anonymous_${Super} Class symbol (ownerName=enclosing type), pushed scope for body members (contains:anonymous_Comparator->compare), classHierarchy.set(anonFqn,[Super]) so pass-1 BFS resolves in-file supertypes (exact-in-file). External-supertype anon bodies stay override-free (truth is in-file). Fixture extended with in-file Handler anon + external forbids; oracle anon mirror added (grails-core 13 anon bodies -> 100/0/0)

decisions.question: C17: collectFieldAccessUses type branch missed annotation_type_declaration — reads inside @interface fell back to the receiver variable
decisions.decision: annotation_type_declaration joins the type-declaration rebind branch. Probe: @interface body read emits Mine->thing

decisions.question: C23: extractStringValue returned raw quoted source for "/a"+"/b" and text blocks
decisions.decision: Constant-folder: literals (string_fragment + multiline_string_fragment), parens, and + chains only; any non-literal operand -> undefined (never fabricated from names). Probe: /a/b and /\n/x\n

decisions.question: C25: only bare 'spring' surfaced patterns; spring_mvc/spring_data/jpa/hibernate flags produced zero pattern payload
decisions.decision: Spring MVC -> mvc_pattern+api_endpoints; Spring Data -> repository_pattern+orm_mapping; JPA/Hibernate -> orm_mapping (first match). Vocabulary matches the spring block

decisions.node_type: syntax-error reporting (ERROR/MISSING vs hasError on typed nodes)
decisions.question: Hygiene: only ERROR/MISSING nodes push errors; hasError on a WELL-TYPED node (a method containing one bad child) is silent
decisions.decision: Ruled intentional: a typed node with an embedded error still ANALYZES correctly (tree-sitter recovery keeps the valid subtree); pushing a file-level error per bad child would flood output on generated/amalgamated files. The C-wave guarantee (error-containing files still emit recoverable content) is the standing probe. receiver_parameter (skip-listed) joins the documented skip set — receiver params (void m(Outer this)) are receiver binders, not user parameters

decisions.question: Hygiene: symbolMap.set(name, sym) bare overwrite lets nested same-name classes (Outer.Inner vs Other.Inner) repoint the alias
decisions.decision: Set-if-absent (first-wins). Verified: the only symbolMap.get is FQN-keyed (override BFS), so bare keys are informational and can never misresolve — the fix removes the silent-repoint hazard

decisions.question: Hygiene: finalFrameworks[0] depended on import order — same file could report spring_mvc or spring depending on which import came first
decisions.decision: Deterministic pickJavaFramework: fixed priority list (spring_data > spring_mvc > spring_core > spring > jpa > hibernate > ...), alphabetical tiebreak. No fixture pinned framework (verified), lanes unaffected

decisions.question: M49 R3 claim 1: overloads collapse to the same bare leaf target (process(String) vs process(int) both -> process) and even metadata carried no discriminator
decisions.decision: Bare-leaf target STAYS the matching contract (JD20; oracle mirrors it) but every calls edge now carries metadata.argumentCount (named children of argument_list) — additive payload; downstream consumers can disambiguate by arity without a resolution engine. Probe: process sites carry argumentCount=1, other.a.b carries 3. Fixture overload-arity-varargs-multicatch pins; mutants java/drop-arity-payload + java/varargs-sig-not-normalized (348/348). Claims 2+3 verified-working and pinned: JLS 8.4.1 int.../int[] equivalence resolves both cross combinations exact-in-file (was true by construction, unproven until this probe); multi-catch unions emit declared_type for EVERY member
